Container.Name: Keen-Kestrel
Container.Overview:
Keen Kestrel is self-hosted error tracking and privacy-friendly analytics in one small Rust binary with SQLite: no Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis or Postgres.
Errors: point the official Sentry SDKs (Swift/iOS, JavaScript, Python, Rust, Go and more) at Kestrel's DSN. Events are scrubbed of personal data and grouped into issues with search, stack traces, resolve/ignore/merge, alerts to ~40 notification services, release health (crash-free sessions and users), and iOS/macOS crash symbolication from dSYMs uploaded with sentry-cli.
Analytics: cookieless web analytics with the 1 KB k.js snippet, and app signals from the KestrelKit Swift package. No IP addresses or user agents are stored, and Global Privacy Control is respected.
Also: a REST API with OpenAPI, MCP tools for coding assistants, users with roles and two-factor login, 26 languages.
Setup: open the WebUI after the first start and create the admin account. Set KK_PUBLIC_URL to the address your apps and sites use (it goes into DSNs, the k.js snippet and alert links). Behind a reverse proxy, set KK_TRUST_PROXY to 1. Everything lives in two SQLite files under /data (appdata).
Container.Requires: Early release (v0.1). To receive events from phones and websites, Kestrel must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS, for example through a reverse proxy or tunnel; set KK_PUBLIC_URL to that address.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web interface, API, ingest (Sentry SDKs, KestrelKit, k.js) and sentry-cli uploads.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: kestrel.sqlite, store.sqlite, uploaded debug files, session key and pre-migration backups. Ownership is set to PUID:PGID on every start.

Config.Name: KK_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The public address apps and sites use, e.g. https://kestrel.example.com. Used in DSNs, the k.js snippet and alert links. Without it, each request's own address is used.

Config.Name: KK_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 when Kestrel is reached through a reverse proxy or tunnel (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Pangolin) that sets X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: KK_SETUP_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the first-run /setup page only opens with ?token=VALUE, so nobody else can create the admin account on an exposed instance.

Config.Name: Ingest port (optional)
Config.Description: Optional second port inside the container that serves only ingest and /healthz, so the admin UI can stay on the LAN. Also map that port below if you use it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).
